# Duzgo Soft (Duzgo OÜ)

> Duzgo Soft is a European software brand operated by Duzgo OÜ (Republic of Estonia), building privacy-first browser utilities and automated cloud accounting software.

## Core Products

- **Duzgo Utility Tools Hub** (https://tools.duzgosoft.com/): 74+ free client-side web tools for PDF editing, merging, splitting, compression, OCR, local AI background removal, batch image/audio conversion, developer JSON/JWT/YAML formatting, and disposable temporary email. All document processing runs locally in the user's browser without permanent server storage.
- **Duzgo Suites Accounting** (https://duzgosoft.com): Automated cloud accounting, double-entry bookkeeping, EU VAT invoicing, and recurring billing software for freelancers and growing businesses.
